title: Vertiv Issues Updated Guidance for Data Centers During Extreme Heat
summary: Summer in the northern hemisphere just started, but already devastating heatwaves have washed over much of the U.S., Mexico, Canada, Europe and Asia. Widespread wildfires in Canada have triggered air quality alerts across that country and much of the eastern half of the U.S. Similar extreme heat events across Asia have caused widespread power outages and deaths, and Europe continues to break heat records as the fastest-warming continent. The data center cooling experts at Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, today issued updated guidance for managing the extreme heat.
